profile.headline: Jr. Software Engineer at OptiSigns | Computer Science at Purdue University

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Next.js · React.js · Machine Learning · PyTorch · Python (Programming Language) · Git · SQL · TypeScript

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed components for Origin, a custom Blazor component library, streamlining the development of web applications for Purdue University using .NET, C#, Blazor, and JavaScript, reducing development time by 30%.
• Revamped website and studio control panel for Video Express, a self-service video production solution, enabling faculty and students to record high-quality videos in 20+ video recording sites across Purdue.
• Implemented the homepage, event code verification, editing events, and sign-in page for BoilerTrack, an attendance tracking platform for career events at Purdue.
• Created unit tests with bUnit for over 30 custom components, improving code coverage.
• Practiced the Agile manifesto and principles to actively communicate with the team on Azure DevOps.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · Blazor · JavaScript · C# · .NET Framework · Git

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Conducted research on modeling human cognitive behaviors, such as self-confidence and trust, within the context of human-automation interaction (HAI) using an MDP model and Reinforcement Learning.
• Analyzed distinct types of learner self-confidence behavior through data partitioning and clustering methods.
• Explored how MDP models can be personalized to individual learners using online model updating.
positions.insights: Skills: MATLAB · Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · Reinforcement Learning

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced and maintained the design and structure of the Purdue Center for Career Opportunities (CCO) website, supporting 5,000+ monthly users on the .NET framework with C#.
• Designed a user interface with an accordion list for Student Resources pages, improving legibility.
• Revised the backend logic of the Asset Management Tool for CCO staff members to enable real-time asset availability tracking and multiple reservations, reducing asset management time by 50%.
• Re-designed MyCareer Campus on the CCO website using Three.js and JavaScript, which introduces Purdue CCO resources in a 3D virtual environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · ASP.NET · JavaScript · HTML/CSS · C# · Responsive Web Design · .NET Framework · Git · SQL

company.name: Purdue University Center for Career Opportunities

positions.title: Customer Success Intern
positions.description:
• Managed and responded to all customer requests, such as FAQs, class registration, class refund, and analyzed customer data to improve the overall learning experience.
• Developed a refund calculator using Javascript to facilitate the refund process and decreased the time consumed on refunds by more than 50 percent.

positions.title: M/W communication equipment operations
positions.description:
• Served in the Republic of Korea Army as an M/W communication equipment operator constructing communication lines, based on Microwave frequencies, between communication centers.
• Acquired hands-on experience with technical communication equipment, in-depth insight on Microwave frequencies, and perception of communication principles.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
• Worked at Hana Bank installing passbook printers and PCs adjusted for Banking purposes.
• Understood the overall mechanism of memory management and computer components, such as Hard Drives, Solid State Drives, and RAM.

projects.title: BoilerGPT
projects.description:
• Developed an instructional chatbot for college courses, generating coherent conversations with the user in a Socratic matter with Prompt Engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
• Applied Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) on a fine-tuned GPT2-Large model, improving response accuracy by 25% and coherence by 30%, as measured through validation tests.
• Implemented a user-friendly UI for individuals to interact with the chatbot using the Python library Streamlit.

projects.title: Purdue Korean Association (PKA) Official Website
projects.description:
• Created a full stack web application connecting 1,000+ students, providing career opportunity updates and a social networking platform for Korean students at Purdue.
• Adopted the SPA architecture to render components and serve web pages using Next.js and Nest.js with TypeScript, reducing page load times by 40% and improving responsiveness.
• Architected relational database models in MySQL with TypeORM and followed RESTful principles of API development by structuring endpoints that respond to HTTPs methods, handling 100 API requests per day.
